verdict.rationale: Fly.io's own marketing says Sprites sleep until they are needed and that you "pay only for the tool calls you use," and general pricing is described as pay-as-you-go for compute actually used. However, nothing documents that idle Machines are unbilled, how auto-stop/auto-start works, or the billing granularity. missing for 10: explicit documentation that idle or stopped Machine time is not billed, per-second or active-time billing details, auto-stop/scale-to-zero mechanics for standard Machines, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can pay only for active compute time rather than idle wall-clock time

citations.quote: Give it a Sprite that sleeps until it's needed and wakes up remembering everything.
Pay only for the tool calls you use.
Fly.io uses pay-as-you-go pricing - you only pay for the compute, storage, and bandwidth you actually use.
